##### Project general facts

Next Point Condominium by Next Point Phuket is an impressive modern residential development created for comfortable living and long-term investment in Phuket. The project features a wide range of residences, including studios, 1-bedroom apartments, 2-bedroom apartments, corner units, and luxurious penthouses with spacious layouts and panoramic views. Designed with a unique architectural concept and managed under Radisson standards, the complex combines elegant design, premium hospitality, and a resort-style atmosphere in one exceptional destination.

The project offers an outstanding collection of lifestyle amenities designed to provide residents with comfort, relaxation, and entertainment every day. Residents can enjoy a spectacular rooftop infinity pool with sea views, rooftop bar, open-air cinema, coworking spaces, fitness center, spa area with hammam and massage rooms, kids’ club, landscaped atrium courtyard, café and restaurant with room service, as well as multiple swimming pools throughout the complex. The development also includes underground parking with EV charging stations, concierge service, lounge areas, and commercial spaces, creating a true all-in-one living environment.

The interiors of Next Point Condominium are beautifully designed in a light-toned minimalist style created by a European design studio, giving every residence a sophisticated and modern feel. Apartments are furnished with elegant Italian furniture made according to individual design projects, while smart home systems and premium plumbing and utility systems from leading European manufacturers add convenience and quality to everyday living. Spacious layouts, panoramic glazing, stylish kitchens, high-quality finishes, and carefully selected materials create bright and airy living spaces that feel both luxurious and welcoming.

##### Parking

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Rawai stands as one of Phuket’s most charming and picturesque coastal destinations, offering a unique blend of tropical serenity, authentic Thai culture, and modern island living. Located along the southern shoreline of Phuket, the area is renowned for its relaxed atmosphere, scenic waterfront promenades, and breathtaking views of the Andaman Sea and nearby islands. With its collection of luxury villas, contemporary residences, seaside restaurants, and vibrant local markets, Rawai presents an exceptional lifestyle that perfectly balances tranquility and sophistication.

Rawai is far more than a residential area - it is a vibrant lifestyle destination designed for leisure, wellness, and outdoor living. Residents and visitors can enjoy easy access to pristine beaches such as Nai Harn and Ya Nui, world-class fitness centers, wellness spas, yacht marinas, and a variety of water activities including island hopping, snorkeling, and sailing. Lush tropical landscapes, beachfront cafes, and peaceful parks further enhance the area’s laid-back ambiance, creating an ideal environment for relaxation and social connection.

The dynamic character of Rawai is enriched by its diverse dining, retail, and entertainment offerings that cater to both locals and international residents. Seafood markets, boutique shops, international schools, and stylish beach clubs are seamlessly integrated into the community, providing convenience alongside an elevated coastal lifestyle. In addition, Rawai’s strategic location allows excellent connectivity to key destinations across Phuket, including Chalong, Kata, Patong, and Phuket International Airport, making it a highly desirable location for both permanent living and holiday retreats.
